name: jarikomppa/soloud
description: Free, easy, portable C/C++ audio engine for games featuring virtual voices, 3D audio, real-time DSP effects, speech synthesis, SID emulation, and bindings for Python, C#, Ruby, GameMaker, and more.
score_rationale: Popular and feature-rich portable audio engine for games with 2.1k stars, Zlib licensed, widely referenced as the best pure-OSS audio engine for indie game developers.
summary: Feature-rich portable audio engine with DSP effects and synthesis
